// diagnostic

E0610

No module named `{alias}` in scope

What

No module named `{alias}` in scope

Why

`use {alias}.item` starts at a module this file declares or brings into scope

Fix

Declare `module {alias}`, or bring the module into scope with `use {alias}`, before this `use`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0610: tests/ui/module_alias_not_module.stderr.

Error [jet.UseAliasNotModule]: No module named `helper` in scope
  --> tests/ui/module_alias_not_module.jet:3:5
    |
  3 | use helper.something
    |     ^^^^^^
 Why: `use helper.item` starts at a module this file declares or brings into scope
 Fix: Declare `module helper`, or bring the module into scope with `use helper`, before this `use`.
